passages.text: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
passages.sermon: Wisdom calls out.\r\nUnderstanding raises her voice.
passages.original: הֲלֹֽא־ חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

passages.text: On the heights overlooking the road, at the crossroads she takes her stand.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom stands on the heights.
She stands where the road is high.
She stands at the crossroads.
She stands where many paths meet.
She overlooks the road.
passages.original: בְּרֹאשׁ־ מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־ דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃

passages.text: Beside the gates to the city, at the entrances she cries out: “To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is a woman who calls out to people.
She stands beside the city gates.
She stands at the entrances to the city.
She raises her voice there.
She calls to all men.
She calls to every person.
She says, “I call out to you, men.
My voice is for all the sons of men.”
passages.original: לְיַד־ שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־ קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃ אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom stands in public places.
She calls out to everyone.
She speaks to those who lack understanding.
Simple people, learn wisdom.
Foolish people, gain understanding.
passages.original: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom stands beside the city gates.
She calls out to all people.
She says, “Listen to me.
I speak noble things.
When I open my lips, I reveal what is right.”
passages.original: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־ נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

passages.text: For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
passages.sermon: I speak the truth.\r\nI hate wickedness.\r\nMy lips reject evil words.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע׃

passages.text: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
passages.sermon: I speak every word with righteousness.\r\nNone of my words are crooked.\r\nNone of my words are perverse.
passages.original: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כָּל־ אִמְרֵי־ פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
passages.sermon: Wisdom speaks these words.\r\nThese words are clear to people who understand.\r\nThese words are right to people who find knowledge.
passages.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃

passages.text: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
passages.sermon:
I speak as wisdom.
I offer instruction.
Take my instruction.
Do not choose silver instead.
I offer knowledge.
Choose my knowledge.
Do not choose pure gold instead.
passages.original: קְחֽוּ־ מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־ כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר׃

passages.text: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
passages.sermon: Wisdom is more precious than rubies.\r\nNothing you desire can compare with wisdom.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל־ חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
passages.sermon:
I am wisdom.
I live with prudence.
I find knowledge.
I find discretion.
passages.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
passages.sermon:
To fear the LORD means to hate evil.
I hate arrogant pride.
I hate evil conduct.
I hate perverse speech.
passages.original: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן׀ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

passages.text: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom possesses counsel.
Wisdom owns sound judgment.
Wisdom has insight.
Wisdom holds strength.
passages.original: לִֽי־ עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃

passages.text: By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws; By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom gives power to kings.
Kings rule because of wisdom.
Rulers make just laws through wisdom.
Princes lead by wisdom.
Nobles judge fairly because of wisdom.
All who govern with justice depend on wisdom.
passages.original: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃ בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל־ שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃

passages.text: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
passages.sermon: Wisdom speaks in this passage.\r\nWisdom loves all who love her.\r\nWisdom allows those who seek her early to find her.
passages.original: אֲ֭נִי אֹהֲבֶיהָ אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃

passages.text: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, “I have riches with me.”
I have honor with me.
I have enduring wealth with me.
I have righteousness with me.
passages.original: עֹֽשֶׁר־ וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה׃

passages.text: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, "My fruit is better than gold."
My fruit is better than pure gold.
My harvest is better than choice silver.
passages.original: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר׃

passages.text: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice, bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, “I walk in the way of righteousness.”
I walk on the paths of justice.
I give wealth to those who love me.
I fill their treasuries.
passages.original: בְּאֹֽרַח־ צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃ לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י׀ יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא׃פ

passages.text: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
passages.sermon:
The LORD created me.
He made me first.
He made me before He did anything else.
He made me before all His works long ago.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃

passages.text: From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, “God established me from everlasting.”
God established me from the very beginning.
God established me before the earth existed.
passages.original: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says God brought me forth.
God brought me forth before the deep waters existed.
No watery depths existed yet.
No springs were overflowing with water yet.
God brought me forth at that time.
passages.original: בְּאֵין־ תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth, before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom existed before God created the world.
Before God set the mountains in place, Wisdom was already there.
Before God formed the hills, Wisdom was brought forth.
Before God made the land, Wisdom existed.
Before God made the open fields, Wisdom was present.
Before God created any dust of the earth, Wisdom was already there.
passages.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃ עַד־ לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃

passages.text: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep, when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth, when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, “I was there when God established the heavens.”
God created the heavens.
I was present at that time.
God drew a circle on the face of the deep.
I was there when He did this.
God made the clouds above strong.
He caused the fountains of the deep to burst forth.
I was there when He did these things.
God set a boundary for the sea.
He commanded the waters not to cross His limit.
I was there when He gave this command.
God marked out the foundations of the earth.
I was present when He did this.
passages.original: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃ בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם׃ בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם׀ חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־ פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom was with God.
Wisdom was a skilled craftsman at God's side.
God delighted in Wisdom every day.
Wisdom rejoiced in God's presence at all times.
passages.original: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכָל־ עֵֽת׃

passages.text: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks in this passage.
Wisdom says, “I was rejoicing in God’s whole world.”
I found delight with the sons of men.
I took joy in all people on the earth.
passages.original: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
passages.sermon: Wisdom speaks to her listeners as sons.\r\nShe says, "Now, my sons, listen to me."\r\nThose who keep my ways are blessed.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks to people.
Wisdom says, “Listen to instruction.
Become wise.
Do not ignore instruction.”
passages.original: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־ תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom speaks to people.
A man who listens to wisdom is blessed.
He watches at the doors of wisdom every day.
He waits at the posts of wisdom’s doorway.
He seeks wisdom constantly.
He pays close attention to wisdom’s entrance.
passages.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל־ דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃

passages.text: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
passages.sermon: Wisdom speaks in this passage.\r\nWhoever finds wisdom finds life.\r\nWhoever finds wisdom receives favor from the LORD.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מֹצְאֵי חַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
passages.sermon: Wisdom speaks in this passage.\r\nWisdom says, “Whoever sins against me hurts himself.\r\nAnyone who hates me loves death.”
passages.original: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־ מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃פ
